proof_policy: Publication does not establish signature/output/security/behavior or native parity. No 11.x runtime exists; current retail 12.1.0 is observed with all later supersessions. Local development, not independent/native acceptance. Cached deprecated wrappers remain intact. Non-inventory contracts remain pending; linked external pages are not expanded. Existing ledgers unchanged.

capabilities.scope: 40 OK / eight exact gaps; seven superseded OK. Five unsuperseded removals establish absence/rejection; zero deprecated-alias acceptances. Publication only.
capabilities.implementation: Four bounded fixes: retire two simulator C_Debug registrations without changing cached wrappers, and extend the existing typed console catalog with two graphics commands. Retail epoch gates preserve earlier profiles; command execution is not modeled.
capabilities.proof: Nine isolated GREEN sweeps; negative control adds exactly one gap. Two bounded behavioral tests GREEN after RED. Mists test check without non-vendor warnings and exit-0 startup [] pass.
